title: Bahtinov processing leaks its binarized frame
summary: indigo_raw_utils.c:3501-3576: indigo_bahtinov_error owns the non-NULL buffer returned by indigo_binarize, then never frees mono on either success or failure return. Agent imager calls it for repeated focus frames at indigo_agent_imager.c:1002. Leaks width*height bytes per frame. Next: Free mono after Hough construction or in common cleanup. Verify repeated success and rejected-spike frames with allocation accounting.
